Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted misleading SERP snippets (e.g., “McLean County, IL” and “Northern Illinois”) as conclusive without verification, failing to cross-check authoritative sources. This led to conflating “McLean” (the community in Virginia) with “McLean County, Illinois,” despite the ZIP 22102 indicating Virginia. The correct location is Tysons/McLean in Fairfax County, Virginia.
